name: entity_is_token_span
rationale: Every gold entity is a contiguous token span of the text, and the label compares lower-cased, stripped strings. So every entity in a correct output, lower-cased and stripped, equals some lower-cased token span. This catches "It's Only...", "(GAMP)", "Dr. Martin Haskell" and "D & E procedure".

name: entity_nonempty
rationale: Gold entities are non-empty token spans, so a correct output never contains an empty or whitespace-only string. This catches degenerate outputs.

name: occurrence_bound
rationale: Each gold entity is a distinct token span. So any string can appear across all fields at most as many times as it occurs in the text. This catches "FIFA World Cup 2018" listed as both art and event when it occurs once.

name: entity_has_alnum
rationale: Named entities always contain at least one letter or digit, so a correct output has no purely punctuation entity. This catches junk extractions such as "(" or "''".

name: no_leading_bad_punct
rationale: Gold spans never start with a closing bracket, comma, period, semicolon or colon token. This catches sloppy span boundaries.

name: no_trailing_bad_punct
rationale: Gold spans never end with an opening bracket, a comma or a semicolon token. This catches boundary errors that overshoot by one token.

name: not_only_stopwords
rationale: A named entity never consists solely of function words. This catches spans like "the" or "of the".

name: total_entities_le_tokens
rationale: Gold spans are non-overlapping and each is at least one token long, so their count cannot exceed the number of tokens. This catches runaway outputs.

name: total_entity_tokens_le_text
rationale: Non-overlapping spans cannot cover more tokens in total than the text contains. This catches outputs with redundant or overlapping material.

name: no_unbalanced_open_paren
rationale: A span that ends right after "(" or contains "(" without ")" is not a valid entity span. This catches truncated parentheticals.

name: no_newlines_in_entity
rationale: The text tokens contain no newlines, so a correct entity, after stripping, contains none either. This catches multi-line junk.

name: no_double_space
rationale: Tokens are joined by single spaces, so a stripped correct entity contains no double spaces unless the text itself does. This catches malformed spans.

name: chars_subset_of_text
rationale: Entities are substrings of the text, so every character of a lower-cased entity appears in the lower-cased text. This catches "It's" when the text lacks such a fused form only in combination with the other checks, and also catches invented characters such as curly quotes.

name: entity_substring_of_text
rationale: A lower-cased stripped entity must be a substring of the lower-cased text. This is a weaker form of the token-span check and catches paraphrased entities.

name: entity_tokens_are_text_tokens
rationale: Each token of a correct entity is a token of the text. This catches merged or split tokens such as "Dr." and "(GAMP)".

name: no_starting_possessive
rationale: A gold span never begins with the clitic "'s". This catches spans like "'s idea".

name: entity_max_length
rationale: Few-NERD entity spans are far shorter than 40 tokens. This catches outputs that dump the whole sentence as an entity.

name: not_whole_sentence
rationale: An entity equal to the entire text of a sentence with more than eight tokens is never gold. This catches copy-the-input failures.

name: no_ampersand_entity_rewrite
rationale: If the text contains "& amp ;", any entity containing "&" must reproduce the exact token sequence. This catches "D & E", which normalises the HTML-escaped form.

name: apostrophe_tokenization
rationale: If an entity contains an apostrophe, its exact spacing must occur in the text. This catches "It's" when the text has "It 's".

name: paren_tokenization
rationale: An entity containing a parenthesis must match the spaced token form found in the text. This catches "Programs (GAMP)".

name: period_tokenization
rationale: An entity containing "." must occur with the text's spacing. This catches "Dr. Martin Haskell" when the text has "Dr . Martin".

name: no_quote_wrapping
rationale: An entity that starts and ends with a quote token must still be a text span. Gold strips the surrounding quotes, so a wrapped form not found in the text is wrong.

name: hyphen_tokenization
rationale: An entity containing a hyphen must occur verbatim, at token boundaries, in the text. This catches hyphens that were invented or had their spacing changed.

name: accent_preserved
rationale: An entity whose de-accented form matches a text token, but whose actual characters do not, is wrong. The label compares exact lower-cased strings, so this catches "Francoise" written for "Françoise".
